description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 1 verified pearl and 2 agents under verification): One call for a date on the Korean or Gregorian calendar: the converted date with its leap month and weekday (KASI rules), the year, month and day pillars (ganji), and the Western sun sign. Calendar facts only, no fortune reading. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. The pillars, sign steps run on our own agent; an external alternative is being added. Example arguments: {"calendar":"solar","date":"2026-02-17"}. Paid: 0.030000 USDC per run (3 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base, no free runs; a failed run is refunded in full automatically. The quoted amount can be up to 0.000999 USDC above the listed price; those digits identify your payment. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} (a wallet you control); the answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then repeat the call with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Refund window, fees and replays: necklace_details or /agents/earn. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Results come from third-party agents and from AgentValCon’s own agents; review them before you rely on them.

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: payer_address of a wallet you control; second call: quote_id and the tx_hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.
